```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
from typing import Mapping, Sequence, Union


class CustomFieldType(Enum):
    """Closed type vocabulary for custom fields. Satisfies AC-02."""
    STRING = "string"
    INTEGER = "integer"
    BOOLEAN = "boolean"
    TIMESTAMP = "timestamp"
    JSON = "json"
    ENUM = "enum"
    WORK_ITEM_REF = "work_item_ref"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FieldSchema:
    """Declared schema for a single custom field. Satisfies AC-02."""
    name: str
    type: CustomFieldType
    enum_values: Sequence[str] = ()


CustomFieldValue = Union[str, int, bool, datetime, dict, list, None]


class ErrorCode(Enum):
    """Structured rejection codes for create_work_item. Satisfies AC-02."""
    WORKFLOW_NOT_REGISTERED = "workflow_not_registered"
    TYPE_NOT_DECLARED_IN_WORKFLOW = "type_not_declared_in_workflow"
    CUSTOM_FIELD_TYPE_VIOLATION = "custom_field_type_violation"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CreateWorkItemError:
    """Rejection result; no partial write occurred. Satisfies AC-02."""
    code: ErrorCode
    message: str
    field_name: Union[str, None]
    original_value: Union[CustomFieldValue, None]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WorkItemCreated:
    """Successful creation result. Satisfies AC-02."""
    work_item_id: str


CreateWorkItemResult = Union[WorkItemCreated, CreateWorkItemError]


def create_work_item(
    project_id: str,
    workflow_name: str,
    workflow_version: str,
    work_item_type: str,
    custom_fields: Mapping[str, CustomFieldValue],
    field_schemas: Mapping[str, FieldSchema],
) -> CreateWorkItemResult:
    """Satisfies AC-02."""
    ...
```
